title: From the Optimal $L^2$-Estimates \((p,n)\) and \((n,p)\)-Forms to Uniform Griffiths \(p\)-Positivity via Convolution and Restriction
summary: We prove that the optimal \(L^2\)-estimate property for \((p,n)\)-forms is preserved under standard convolution regularization. As an application, we show that a singular Hermitian metric satisfying the optimal \(L^2\)-estimate property for \((p,n)\)-forms is uniform Griffiths \(p\)-positive. By establishing the restriction property, we prove that a singular Hermitian metric satisfying the optimal \(L^2\)-estimate property for \((n,p)\)-forms is also uniform Griffiths \(p\)-positive.
